scripts.manual:pdf: npx --yes md-to-pdf USER_MANUAL.md --config-file ./md-to-pdf.config.cjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('docs',{recursive:true});fs.mkdirSync('src-tauri/resources',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('USER_MANUAL.pdf','docs/USER_MANUAL.pdf');fs.copyFileSync('USER_MANUAL.pdf','src-tauri/resources/USER_MANUAL.pdf');console.log('Synced PDF to docs/ and src-tauri/resources/')"
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked -- -D warnings
